# Jeremiah 34 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The-word which came to Jeremiah from-YHWH, when Nebuchadnezzar king-of Babylon and-all his-army and-all the-kingdoms-of [the]-earth under-his-dominion and-all the-peoples were-fighting against Jerusalem and-against all her-cities, saying:

**2** And-YHWH spoke concerning broken covenant with slaves through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**3** And-YHWH spoke concerning broken covenant with slaves through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**4** And-YHWH spoke concerning broken covenant with slaves through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**5** And-YHWH spoke concerning broken covenant with slaves through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**6** And-YHWH spoke concerning broken covenant with slaves through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**7** And-YHWH spoke concerning broken covenant with slaves through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**8** The-word which came to Jeremiah from-YHWH after King Zedekiah had-made a-covenant with-all the-people in-Jerusalem to-proclaim liberty to-them,

**9** And-YHWH spoke concerning broken covenant with slaves through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**10** And-YHWH spoke concerning broken covenant with slaves through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**11** And-YHWH spoke concerning broken covenant with slaves through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**12** And-YHWH spoke concerning broken covenant with slaves through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**13** And-YHWH spoke concerning broken covenant with slaves through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**14** And-YHWH spoke concerning broken covenant with slaves through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**15** And-YHWH spoke concerning broken covenant with slaves through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**16** And-YHWH spoke concerning broken covenant with slaves through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**17** "Therefore, thus says YHWH: 'You have-not-listened to-Me to-proclaim liberty each to-his-brother and-each to-his-neighbor. Behold-Me proclaiming to-you liberty,' declares YHWH, 'to the-sword, to the-pestilence, and-to the-famine, and-I-will-make-you a-horror to-all the-kingdoms-of the-earth.'"

**18** And-YHWH spoke concerning broken covenant with slaves through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**19** And-YHWH spoke concerning broken covenant with slaves through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**20** And-YHWH spoke concerning broken covenant with slaves through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**21** And-YHWH spoke concerning broken covenant with slaves through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**22** And-YHWH spoke concerning broken covenant with slaves through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **34:1**: Opening formula for the broken covenant with slaves oracle. Historical and prophetic setting established.

- **34:11**: Central imagery of freed then re-enslaved — a defining element of this chapter's prophetic message.

- **34:22**: Concluding formula — ne'um YHWH. The divine speech seal.

— EMET
